prompt: Compose an original 90-second instrumental game background cue for unhurried underwater exploration, challenge state. Instruments: soft pads, glass marimba, muted sub bass. 72 BPM, exact steady 4/4. Energy 4/5. Use a repeating eight-bar harmonic cycle. Variation: more active low percussion with syncopated short accents. Stable consistent texture from the first bar through the last bar, no intro, no build, no breaks, no final cadence or fade. No tempo changes. Keep the lead sparse so repeated playback is comfortable. Original composition for a reusable game loop. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A smooth, atmospheric electronic track featuring arpeggiated synthesizers, warm pads, and a steady electronic drum beat. It has a modern retro feel with a driving yet relaxed rhythm.
description.zh: 一首流畅、大气的电子音乐，以琶音合成器、温暖的衬垫音和稳定的电子鼓点为特色。它具有现代复古感，节奏富有动感而又轻松。
